profile_completeness: Every finite rank-nine Coxeter stabilizer is spherical. Its diagram is a forest, has maximum vertex degree three, and a degree-three vertex has only label-three edges. Degree-two attachments use labels at most five. Unbounded labels occur only when the new vertex joins an isolated old A1, giving a separate I2(m) tail. These cases are exhaustively tested by the exact Schur complement on each positive-definite support. Profiles are necessary local possibilities, not globally compatible caps.
scope: Complete projective extreme-ray census for these twelve actual walls, together with all outgoing directions at finite vertices and exact feasible spacelike continuations for open directions. These data describe the present chamber, not an all-parameter completion obstruction or a finite-volume example.
